walkthroughs.body_html:
M = I ÷ A.

I = image size, A = actual size. Convert units before dividing — 1 mm = 1000 μm = 1 000 000 nm.

60 cm³ of O₂ in 30 s, mean rate = 60 ÷ 30 = 2 cm³/s.

To find rate at a moment, find the gradient of a tangent on a graph.

Human enzymes have optimum near 37 °C and most prefer pH 7. Stomach pepsin prefers pH ~2.

Above optimum, rate falls because enzymes denature.

mcqs.q: How do insulin and glucagon work together to regulate blood glucose?
options: They are antagonistic — insulin lowers blood glucose (cells take up glucose, store as glycogen); glucagon raises it (glycogen broken back down to glucose).
Insulin works on muscles and glucagon works on the brain.
Insulin and glucagon both lower blood glucose using different mechanisms.

mcqs.q: What is the key difference between mitosis and meiosis?
options: Mitosis produces two genetically identical diploid cells; meiosis produces four genetically different haploid cells (gametes).
Mitosis and meiosis both produce gametes; they are basically the same.
Mitosis happens in plants and meiosis happens in animals.

mcqs.q: Why is negative feedback the default mechanism in homeostasis?
options: It opposes deviations from a set point, returning the variable toward its normal value — keeping internal conditions stable.
Negative feedback amplifies changes to make them more noticeable.
Negative feedback only operates when something goes wrong in the body.
